C1186.title: SolarWinds Orion Software Update Backdoor Incident
C1186.summary: In December 2020, CISA reported that an advanced persistent threat actor had used a SolarWinds Orion software supply-chain compromise to intrude into U.S. government agencies, critical infrastructure entities, and private organizations. The actor altered a dynamic-link library used by Orion products and entered victim environments through trusted updates. CISA directed affected organizations to isolate vulnerable versions, reset credentials, and investigate follow-on activity.
